name: sdg11
title: SDG 11: Sustainable cities and communities (SDG Atlas of Bolivia 2026)
description: The SDG 11 (Sustainable cities and communities) index of the Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026 (SDSN Bolivia) and the 7 indicators behind it, for Bolivia's 343 municipalities and indigenous autonomies (GAIOC), at two points in time: near the 2012 census and near the 2024 census, stored as 2012 and 2024 so that their change can be studied.

sources.title: Andersen, L. E., & Argandoña, F. (2026). Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026: Brechas y tendencias del desarrollo sostenible en las Entidades Territoriales Autónomas, 2012–2024. La Paz: Universidad Privada Boliviana, SDSN Bolivia.

geo:citation: GeoDevelopment Observatory of Bolivia (2026). SDG 11: Sustainable cities and communities, from the Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026 (343 municipalities, ~2012 and ~2024). https://github.com/quarcs-lab/gdo4bolivia/blob/main/docs/datasets/sdg11.md
geo:notes: Both periods are stored at nominal years: 2012 for the Atlas's initial values (~2012) and 2024 for its final values (~2024). Each indicator's actual reference years differ (e.g. 2008 and 2023 for the health survey, three-year averages for volatile indicators) and are given in its description and in `geo:reference_years`.
Load one variable in both periods, e.g. `geo.load("sdg11", variables="index_sdg11", names=True)`, and its change per unit with `geo.change(df, "index_sdg11")`.

The units are the 343 municipalities and indigenous autonomies (GAIOC) of 2025. Four of them were created after the 2012 census (TIOC-Raqaypampa, San Pedro de Macha, TIOC-Jatun Ayllu Yura and TIOC-Territorio Indígena Multiétnico); the Atlas gives them values in both periods.

Aggregating to provinces, departments or Bolivia (`geo.aggregate`, `geo.combine`) averages the municipal values weighted by census population (`weighted_mean:population`; the 2012 census for ~2012 and the 2024 census for ~2024, loaded from the `sdg` dataset through `geo:weights`): e.g. `geo.aggregate(geo.load("sdg11"), to="department", dataset="sdg11")`. These are population-weighted approximations, not the Atlas's own department figures.

fields.name: geo_id
fields.title: Municipality ID
fields.description: GDO-Bolivia municipality geo ID (BO-DD-PP-MM) of the 343-unit municipality map (SDSN Bolivia 2025: municipalities and indigenous autonomies), numbered as in GADM 4.1 plus four units created since; map343; its boundary is in geo/boundaries/map343. It nests by prefix into the department (BO-DD) and province (BO-DD-PP) IDs; department and province numbers follow GADM order and differ from INE codes.

fields.name: year
fields.title: Period
fields.description: Period of the values in the row: 2012 holds the Atlas's initial values (near the 2012 census) and 2024 its final values (near the 2024 census). Each variable's actual reference years are given in its description and in geo:reference_years.

fields.name: mun_id
fields.title: INE municipality code
fields.description: Official municipality code of the National Statistics Institute (INE), DDPPMM (department, province, municipality) stored as an integer without the leading zero (e.g. 20101 = Nuestra Señora de La Paz), as in the Atlas. The Atlas's rows are linked to geo_id through this code.
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: index_sdg11
fields.title: Sustainable cities and communities index (0-100)
fields.description: SDG 11 (Sustainable cities and communities) index of the Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026, on a 0-100 scale where 100 means the goal's targets are met and 0 the worst situation. Following the global SDG Index of SDSN, each of its 7 indicators is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between a worst and a best value (given in each indicator's description), with the direction set so that higher is always better and values beyond the bounds capped; the index is the simple mean of the available rescaled indicators. Components: Overcrowded households (%); Households without a toilet (%); Adequate housing (% of dwellings); Public-transport seats (per 1,000 people); Public spending on solid waste (Bs per person per year); Solid-waste collection (% of dwellings); PM2.5 concentration (µg/m³). Initial value (~2012) stored at 2012 and final value (~2024) at 2024; its components refer to different years around each census. Atlas: “Índice ODS11”.
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: sdg11_1_thm
fields.title: Overcrowded households (%)
fields.description: Percentage of households with more than two people per bedroom. Source: own calculation of the Atlas from the INE Population and Housing Censuses of 2012 and 2024. Initial value 2012 (stored at 2012) and final value 2024 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 11 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 68.2 (worst, 0) and 12.6 (best, 100), lower is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 15 and major challenges from 30 on. Atlas indicator 11_01_01_01_thm, “Porcentaje de hogares con hacinamiento” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: sdg11_1_ssb
fields.title: Households without a toilet (%)
fields.description: Percentage of households without a toilet, bathroom or latrine. Source: own calculation of the Atlas from the INE Population and Housing Censuses of 2012 and 2024. Initial value 2012 (stored at 2012) and final value 2024 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 11 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 100 (worst, 0) and 0 (best, 100), lower is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 15 and major challenges from 50 on. Atlas indicator 11_01_01_02_ssb, “Porcentaje de hogares sin servicio sanitario o baño” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: sdg11_1_ava
fields.title: Adequate housing (% of dwellings)
fields.description: Percentage of dwellings that INE rates as adequate (high average rating in construction materials of walls, roof and floor; basic services; and overcrowding). Source: INE tabulations of the INE Population and Housing Censuses of 2012 and 2024. Initial value 2012 (stored at 2012) and final value 2024 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 11 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 0 (worst, 0) and 100 (best, 100), higher is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 85 and major challenges from 50 on. Atlas indicator 11_01_01_03_ava, “Porcentaje de viviendas adecuadas” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: sdg11_2_atc
fields.title: Public-transport seats (per 1,000 people)
fields.description: Seats available in collective transport per 1,000 inhabitants: buses, microbuses and minibuses registered in the municipal vehicle fleet times their seats. Source: INE, vehicle fleet by municipality. Initial value 2012 (stored at 2012) and final value 2024 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 11 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 0 (worst, 0) and 342 (best, 100), higher is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 93 and major challenges from 5 on. Atlas indicator 11_02_01_04_atc, “Asientos disponibles en transporte colectivo (por 1,000 habitantes)” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: sdg11_6_ipr
fields.title: Public spending on solid waste (Bs per person per year)
fields.description: Municipal public investment and spending on solid-waste management per person, averaged over three years. Source: Fundación Jubileo (2024), budgets of the autonomous municipal governments by programme and type of spending. Initial value average 2012–2014 (stored at 2012) and final value average 2022–2024 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 11 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 0 (worst, 0) and 287.7 (best, 100), higher is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 200 and major challenges from 50 on. Atlas indicator 11_06_01_05_ipr, “Inversión y gasto público municipal en residuos sólidos (Bs./persona/año)” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: sdg11_6_srr
fields.title: Solid-waste collection (% of dwellings)
fields.description: Percentage of dwellings that dispose of their waste through a public bin or container or a collection truck. Source: INE tabulations of the INE Population and Housing Censuses of 2012 and 2024. Initial value 2012 (stored at 2012) and final value 2024 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 11 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 0 (worst, 0) and 100 (best, 100), higher is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 90 and major challenges from 10 on. Atlas indicator 11_06_01_06_srr, “Porcentaje de viviendas con servicio de recolección de residuos sólidos” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: sdg11_6_ica
fields.title: PM2.5 concentration (µg/m³)
fields.description: Mean annual concentration of fine particulate matter (PM2.5) in the populated areas of the municipality: satellite PM2.5 estimates averaged over INE census blocks, averaged over three years. Source: MODIS Terra-Aqua satellite PM2.5 estimates and INE census blocks. Initial value average 2010–2012 (stored at 2012) and final value average 2021–2023 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 11 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 31 (worst, 0) and 5 (best, 100), lower is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 10 and major challenges from 25 on. Atlas indicator 11_06_02_07_ica, “Concentración media anual de PM2.5 (µg/m3)” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
